capabilities: Search your Memex library from a sidebar without leaving the vault
Ask questions across your Memex account
Drag Memex results into notes as result cards
Pull-import Memex content into notes via configurable rules
Edit import templates stored as Markdown files in the vault
extras: Pull imports are disabled by default and must be enabled in settings with a poll interval and import rules. Login troubleshooting via paste callback URL is documented.
problem: Saved web pages, highlights, PDFs and other Memex content stay outside the vault, so users must leave Obsidian to search or cite them.

relations.evidence: Memex brings your Memex library into Obsidian Desktop.

summary: Memex integration that lets you search your Memex bookmarking library in Obsidian, import saved content as notes, and ask questions across it.
